queries: November 2026 AI funding Anthropic IPO financing Microsoft cash flow Huang

sources_considered.why: Readable reporting distinguishes existing obligations from decisions about future financing.
Continuing financing discussions do not establish either completed alternative funding or its adequacy.
The readable prospectus described one company's earlier financial position and prospective liquidity. It did not establish industry-wide support after NVIDIA's assumed withdrawal.
One financing announcement cannot establish the remaining support or financing needs of the industry.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph discussing NVIDIA's existing signed commitments

receipt.public_excerpt: Some promises can't be taken back.

evidence_items.explanation: The surrounding paragraph says existing signed obligations remained owed. This qualifies the premise that NVIDIA's financial support had disappeared with Huang, but does not measure the adequacy of remaining industry support.

unresolved_gaps: A withdrawal of NVIDIA funding has not been established.
No comparable assessment measures remaining independent support against the financing needs of the industry.
Evidence about dependent startups cannot automatically be generalized to hyperscalers or the entire industry.
